note: The first input byte selects the architecture/mode, steering execution into the x86 disassembly path.
The x86 mapping code copies implicit register metadata into the instruction detail object.

The code assumes the copied implicit-register array is fully initialized and uses its count to drive later reads; the missing safety obligation is that the count must not exceed the initialized elements.
The untrusted count is consumed to copy implicit registers out of the detail structure, triggering the uninitialized-value read when the count covers uninitialized entries.
